name_reason: Follows the file convention fd2_chapter_event_handler_<idx>__<chapter>_<category>. '2e' is the dispatch table index (slot 0x2E of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91; confirmed by the only xref, a DATA pointer at 0x51c49 whose 4 bytes are CC 50 03 00 = 0x000350cc), NOT an address residue (the function's own address is 0x350cc). 'ch19' = chapter 19 (meaningful chapter ID). 'reinforcement' correctly classifies the body, which recruits a reinforcement char via fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth. No address residue. Matches every sibling handler in chevt1.c.
purpose: Chapter 19 turn-event slot 1 (dispatch idx 0x2E): the turn-6 reinforcement beat that reloads portrait set 1, shows dialog page 1, and recruits char_id 0x1B (龍劍士巴拿羅西亞 / Banarosia) as a reinforcement.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch, no-RNG sequence. __CHK(0x28) stack probe (compiler-injected). fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) reloads portrait set 1. fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=1, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) shows dialog page 1 with the group's fixed dialog geometry; its uint32 return is discarded. fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(0x1B) appends one menu-party (template_chars) roster slot built from the static char_base+char_growth tables (writes team=2/player, char_id at +7 and +8) and increments the member count. event_arg is never read. Disassembly (PUSH 0x28;CALL __CHK / PUSH 1;CALL load_portraits / 8 dialog PUSHes + [0x53a79];CALL display_dialog / PUSH 0x1b;CALL init_runtime_char / RET) matches the src exactly. Cross-checked against chapter_19 walkthrough: 'after the player's 6th turn, 巴拿羅西亞 appears at the bottom to help; recruit: 龍劍士巴拿羅西亞'.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform dispatch argument passed by the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (all slots are 1-arg cdecl). This handler never reads it; it is only the stack value implicitly visible to the __CHK stack-probe prologue. Cast to (void) in the body.
params.reason: Name accurately describes the role (the dispatch table's per-event argument) and matches every sibling handler. Not param_1, not a generic placeholder, no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: portrait reload, dialog display, and one appended menu-party roster slot (member count incremented).

comment_original_issue: Comment content was accurate and concise, but contained two non-ASCII em-dashes (U+2014) at the lines describing the chapter/slot and the fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth recruit, violating the code-text-ASCII-only rule.
notes: Indirect global read of data_fd2_current_chapter_text confirmed via xref_from 0x350f9 (READ to 0x53a79 = data_fd2_current_chapter_text). The two roster-slot byte writes (team=2, char_id) live inside the callee fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth, not in this handler, so writes_globals is empty for this function. Plate left unchanged: it already states dispatch idx 0x2E / ch19 turn 6 / reinforcement spawner / the 3-call sequence / __CHK(0x28) / no params, all consistent with the refined src. comment_verdict=rewrite reflects only the two em-dash -> '--' ASCII fixes; the prose was not otherwise changed. Walkthrough SOT line in the src comment (assets/chapters/chapter_19.md) cross-checked against fd2-knowledge chapter 19 events.
